ID: BRABAH1								
Country: Brazil								
City: Bahia								
Period: January to April 1846								
Resolution: Daily 								
Observers: J. J. Rodrigues, a doctor who published several paper in the journal, most of them related to medicine.								
Location Observatory: -12.96, -38.50								
Meteorological variables: Temperature at 6h, 14h, 19h (Celsius) (Columns 4, 5, 6), (Celsius); Temperature at 6h, 14h, 19h (Columns 7, 8, 9) (Reaumur).								
Data source: Archivo Médico Brasileiro 1844-1847								
Descriptive Name: BAHIA_1846 								
Other comments:  The observer chose this area of the city because it was far from the city centre, and nothing could block the wind and the solar radiation.
